limitation: Convergence and posterior fit do not identify interventions
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: A specified likelihood/prior and observed/missing variables.
scientific_qualification.output: Posterior draws or variational approximation and predictive quantities conditional on the model.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: A properly defined probabilistic target, computational convergence/approximation and separately justified causal semantics.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Record likelihood factors and intervention transformation. pm.do/pm.observe syntax changes a supplied model; it does not establish that a bank's causal graph or latent mechanisms are identified.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare a conjugate posterior and a marginalized finite latent model to exact values; introduce observationally equivalent causal completions and verify prior sensitivity remains visible.

evidence.finding: MCMC/VI features and explicit do/observe example.
